title: Avoiding the most common financial errors in Horizon Europe projects
summary: Commission session on preparing for an audit and avoiding the most common and most costly financial errors in Horizon Europe projects.
body: This live session, streamed on 16 September 2026 on the European Commission's EU Science & Innovation channel, is aimed at beneficiaries that are already running Horizon Europe projects.
It explains how to prepare for an audit and how to avoid the errors in project finances that are most frequent and most expensive, followed by a questions-and-answers session.
why: Ullswater Investments note: winning the grant is only half the job. Errors found in an audit can mean returning funds, so project coordinators and finance teams should review their cost reporting against these points from the start of the project.
